item.title: Switchboard 0.3.1
item.description:
What's new

  • Nothing visible. This release exists so that 0.3.0 can prove it finds, downloads, and installs an update on its own.

item.title: Switchboard 0.3.0
item.description:
What's new

  • Automatic updates. Switchboard now checks its GitHub releases for new versions and installs them. On the second launch it asks once whether it may check automatically. Each update is verified against the feed's signature and the app's own code signature before it replaces the app.
  • Updates in Settings. The installed version, a link to its notes, a Check Now button, when the last check ran, and switches for checking and installing automatically. Check for Updates is also in the app menu and the menu bar item's menu.

This is the first version that can update itself. Copies of 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 must be replaced by hand once.

item.title: Switchboard 0.2.0
item.description:
What's new

  • Settings screen (Command-comma, or Settings… in the menu bar item's menu): choose the light, dark, or system appearance, and hide the Dock icon. With the icon hidden, Switchboard lives in the menu bar only.
  • Menu bar item click: a click opens the window, or closes it when it is already in front. A right click or control click shows the memory menu with the total, one line per app, Open, Settings, and Quit.

Fixes

  • The window now comes to the front when opened from the menu bar item while another app is active.
